required_provenance_fields: migrated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
migration_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (migration_status IN ('imported','verified','superseded','rejected'))
required_destination_migrations: Create table migration_review_queue(id uuid pk, source_table text, source_id text, reason text, payload jsonb, created_at, resolved_at, resolution text).
Create table migration_user_map(legacy_uid uuid pk, new_uid uuid not null unique, matched_by text check (matched_by in ('uid','email_verified')), created_at).
Create table migration_org_map(legacy_tenant_id uuid pk, new_org_id uuid not null unique, matched_by text check (matched_by in ('legacy_id','domain','owner_email')), created_at).

Create table migration_candidate_map(legacy_id uuid, legacy_table text, new_candidate_profile_id uuid not null, matched_by text check (matched_by in ('legacy_id','email','phone','manual')), created_at, primary key (legacy_id, legacy_table)).

Add provenance columns (legacy_source_system, legacy_source_table, legacy_source_id, migrated_at, migration_run_id, migration_version, migration_status) to: profiles, organizations, memberships, positions, screening_questions, candidate_profiles, applications, application_answers, candidate_matches, files, candidate_evidence, score_runs, client_decisions, interviews, messages, notifications, audit_events, intake_submissions, consent_records.
Add UNIQUE index on (legacy_source_table, legacy_source_id) per migrated table to enforce idempotency.
Add CHECK constraint app_role does not include legacy 'super_admin' unless mapped to platform_admin membership.

entities.destination_org_key: n/a on auth.users; profiles has NO org column (org linkage lives in memberships)
entities.conflict_policy: Match legacy uid via migration_user_map; if absent, match by lower(email) ONLY when legacy email_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND no existing destination user shares that normalized email. Otherwise reject.
validation: legacy row.email_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND legacy row.deleted_at IS NULL
rejection: banned_until in future → reject to review queue
duplicate normalized email in source without a distinguishing verified uid → reject both, manual merge

field_map.id: → new uuid; store (legacy_uid, new_uid) in migration_user_map
field_map.email_confirmed_at: verbatim; required NOT NULL for MIGRATE_ALL_VERIFIED

entities.provenance_written_to: public.profiles (auth-schema rows cannot carry provenance columns)

entities.conflict_policy: Insert-if-missing keyed by auth_user_id (resolved via migration_user_map). If destination row exists and was updated via app after migration_run start → NEVER overwrite; merge only null-in-destination fields.

field_map.full_name / first_name / last_name: trim + collapse whitespace; split into first/last if destination stores separately
field_map.avatar_url: verbatim; NOT copied through Storage in this phase (public URL only)

entities.null_handling: empty strings → NULL; unknown enum → reject
entities.json_handling: notification_prefs, metadata preserved; unknown keys retained

entities.conflict_policy: Match legacy id via migration_org_map; if absent, match by verified primary domain (owner email domain OR verified custom domain). NEVER fuzzy-match on company name.

field_map.name: trim; not lowercased
field_map.billing_email: lower(trim); must be a migrated user's email or NULL
field_map.industry: map via industries lookup; unknown → NULL
field_map.logo_url: not copied through Storage in this phase

validation: at least one migrated membership row must exist
rejection: 0 memberships AND 0 requisitions → reject as empty tenant

entities.source_table: public.user_roles + implicit tenant-user link on requisitions/candidate_submissions
entities.conflict_policy: Insert-if-missing keyed by (organization_id, user_id, role).

enum_transformations.'recruiter' / 'ops': → memberships.role='operations' (platform staff) OR memberships.role='client_editor' (client staff) — DISAMBIGUATE per source flag; ambiguous → review queue

rejection: unresolved user or org → reject to review queue

entities.conflict_policy: Insert-if-missing keyed by legacy_source_id. If destination position with same legacy_source_id exists and status='active' in destination but legacy is 'closed' → NEVER downgrade; keep destination.

field_map.title: trim
field_map.description / responsibilities / require: concatenate into positions.description (markdown); split requirements into positions.requirements[] JSONB with {label, weight, must_have}

entities.date_transformations: all timestamps → UTC; naïve times rejected
entities.array_handling: skills[] normalized via skills dictionary (unknown skills preserved as free text)

entities.conflict_policy: Insert-if-missing; MUST resolve to a migrated position.

1) match by (legacy_id, legacy_table); 2) match by verified user_id via migration_user_map; 3) match by lower(email) IF single deterministic match AND legacy email_verified; 4) match by E.164 phone AS TIE-BREAKER only; NEVER match by name alone. Ambiguous → review queue.

field_map.user_id: remap via migration_user_map (NULL for unclaimed candidates)
field_map.full_name: trim; split into first/last only if unambiguous
field_map.current_cv_file_id: REMAPPED after files migration (see below); NULL until then
field_map.provenance JSONB: regenerated during hydration — do NOT copy legacy candidate_field_provenance

rejection: duplicate normalized email that maps to distinct legacy candidates AND no phone/uid tie-breaker → review queue
no email, no phone, no user_id → review queue (cannot bind identity)

entities.source_pk: job_applications.id (each row explodes into application + candidate_match)
entities.conflict_policy: Insert-if-missing keyed by legacy_source_id. Do NOT re-open a destination application that was closed after migration_run start.

field_map.reference_code: verbatim if 6-char alnum unique; else regenerate
field_map.source: enum {'job_board','referral','import','admin'} — legacy free text mapped; unknown → 'import'
field_map.answers jsonb (inlined): explode into application_answers rows keyed by screening_question mapping

entities.conflict_policy: Insert-if-missing. If (position_id, candidate_profile_id) already exists in destination with a later approved_score_run_id → NEVER overwrite; log as superseded.

field_map.application_id: via applications migration; NULL if no source application
field_map.processing_state: reset to 'queued' — real state rebuilt from files+score_runs

field_map.approved_score_run_id: REMAPPED after score_runs migration; NULL until then
field_map.client_view_snapshot jsonb: regenerated on destination; do NOT copy stale copy

rejection: MIME/size out of policy → reject; orphan (no candidate) → reject

entities.conflict_policy: REBUILD_FROM_CANONICAL_DATA. Historical score_runs (see below) carry their own frozen evidence JSONB.
rejection: do not import stale evidence — regenerate against destination parser

entities.conflict_policy: REBUILD_FROM_CANONICAL_DATA. Enrichment history → audit_events.

entities.conflict_policy: Blocked pending product decision (Phase 2 REQUIRES_REVIEW).

entities.conflict_policy: Insert-if-missing keyed by legacy_source_id; never re-apply a decision to advance destination stage backward.

entities.conflict_policy: Insert-if-missing. Group by (thread.tenant→org, thread.subject→(position,candidate_profile)) — destination has no explicit thread table.
